t: Manchester United is for sale, who could buy the world-famous club? | CNN
s: March 22, 2023 - Sheikh Jassim is the son of Qatar’s former Prime Minister Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jaber Al Thani, and, reportedly, is a lifelong Manchester United fan. His bid, soccer finance expert Kieran Maguire tells CNN Sport, would “effectively … take the club private again,” eliminating all the debt, and buying out “not just the Glazer family, but everybody else that owns shares in Manchester United as well.”
